item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Meera notices that the school calendar shows both Gregorian dates and dates from the Indian National Calendar used on official government documents.

How should the Indian National Calendar be classified?

options.A: an official solar calendar used along with the Gregorian calendar
options.B: a lunar calendar based only on the phases of the Moon
options.C: a private calendar used only for religious festivals
options.D: an international calendar that has replaced the Gregorian calendar
